title: framework-lock.json
description: Normative schema for the integration lockfile (docs/INTEGRATION.md §3). Written by integrate.py init; hand-written locks from pre-tool integrations must conform when re-pinned.

repo.description: Framework repo URL or slug; null when init ran from a tarball with no git metadata

ref.description: Pinned ref: a release tag once releases exist, a bare commit hash before

version.description: Framework version string; 'unreleased' before the first tag

integrated_at.description: ISO-8601 date of the last init/upgrade that wrote this lock

method.description: Tool and version that wrote the lock, or 'hand-executed' for pre-tool instances

taken.description: The copy-manifest subset this host adopted; everything downstream (overlay stubs, validate, smoke) scopes to it

files.description: Per-file sha256 of every taken core-layer file, keyed by host-relative path

base_sha256.description: Checksum of the retained pristine upstream copy the fork diverged from

instance_layer.description: Host-original trees that follow framework conventions but are not copies
